_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 42: 3-10 December 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says he knows the timeframe and is giving it to them, that it was three years and six months, then three years and four months, and that it keeps going down, recalling the Lord saying he was giving a reprieve.
mentions.quote: It was three years and six months, three years and four months
mentions.falsify_match: A terminal event roughly three years out and shortening.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A countdown that keeps being restated from the present never runs out.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the tourist industry down in Florida where people gather a lot, and strategic plans to infiltrate the security of Mickey Mouse, the Magic Kingdom and such.
mentions.quote: strategic plans to infiltrate the security of Mickey Mouse, Magic Kingdom
mentions.falsify_match: A security breach or plot at a Florida theme park.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Fifth named venue in six weeks with no act and no date.

mentions.claim_text: He is prompted for the word relevancy, says the networks are losing their relevancy, and that because of this the Lord told him they will come out with a plan concerning 2026 and 2028.
mentions.quote: THEY WILL COME OUT WITH A plan concerning 2026 and 2028
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated media effort around the two election cycles.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The plan is not described, so almost any coverage decision could be read as it.

mentions.claim_text: He says a running mate or DeSantis would be an amazing power team, that he is believing God that Don Jr would throw his hat in the ring so they could keep the Trump name, and that he is believing for that for 2028.
mentions.quote: believing God that Don Jr. would throw his hat in the ring
mentions.falsify_match: Don Jr entering the 2028 race.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not. Marked as what he is believing for rather than what he saw, which sits oddly beside vance-2028-realignment.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are licking their wounds from the last couple of years and regrouping, naming the Islamic Brotherhood and Iran, that they are getting ready, and that what he saw coming will be worse than October 7th.
mentions.quote: for what I saw coming will be worse than October 7th
mentions.falsify_match: An attack exceeding 7 October 2023.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Fourth telling in three weeks and still no date.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told to teach them how to hear him because they are not being taught in the church, to draw close, because the seeker friendly skinny jeans and fog machine churches are there to give a thirty minute watered down message.
mentions.quote: the seeker friendly SKINNY JEANS AND FOG MACHINE churches
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He prays thanking God that he is cleaning up the church and cleaning up politics, and that the truth will be revealed of who they are looking at, sooner rather than later.
mentions.quote: the truth will be revealed of who we're looking at
mentions.falsify_match: An identity revealed.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Who they are looking at is never said.

mentions.claim_text: He says they should not think what comes in 2026 is only about the charismatics and the seeker friendlies, reporting the Lord saying he is cleansing his church and his whole bride, and that it does not belong to one denomination.
mentions.quote: I am cleansing my whole bride. And that does not belong to one denomination
mentions.falsify_match: Scandals across multiple denominations in 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Widening the target from one tradition to all of them makes a match easier, not harder.

mentions.claim_text: He says he felt a parting and a major shift coming and that afterwards you could feel they made a lot of progress in prayer concerning this gate, and that before prayer he saw a lot in the spirit concerning February 3rd.
mentions.quote: I saw a lot in the spirit concerning February 3rd
mentions.falsify_match: Something notable on 3 February 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: The date passes quietly. The content is still not specified in any of the five tellings.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the number three going down the mountain like an alpine skier, repeats number three, and says he knows it is symbolic because a number three is not going to go down a mountain.
mentions.quote: the number three going down the mountain like it was an alpine skier
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and he says so: he knows it is symbolic and does not say of what.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says there will be a great shaking to awaken in 2026 and that this is what will bring the bride by his side, that the 2026 shaking brings the bride by his side in a great awakening, and repeats that he warned them.
mentions.quote: The 2026 shaking will bring the bride by my side
mentions.falsify_match: Shakings in 2026 followed by measurable church growth.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. The shaking is the mechanism, so hardship confirms it.

mentions.claim_text: He says much trafficking of young girls and boys comes from this city and great perversion comes from Monaco, apologises for being bad with names, and says that as he saw this manifesting the Lord spoke further.
mentions.quote: much trafficking of young girls and boys comes from this city
mentions.falsify_match: Trafficking prosecutions or reporting centred on Monaco.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. An unevidenced accusation against a named place, and he is unsure of the name as he says it.

mentions.claim_text: He anticipates people asking what he was saying and answers that he does not know and has to keep praying about it because he hears in part and sees in part and it is all a puzzle to him, then says he saw a rebellion and these things coming.
mentions.quote: I hear in part see in part and it's all a puzzle to me
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the plainest statement of the in-part clause yet: he does not claim to understand his own material.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He describes something like a cave and the Lord saying he will hide him, that much refining has gone through his life all the way up, and that the Lord went by the sixes, saying there was a major shaking in his life in 2016.
mentions.quote: he went by the sixes. In 2016 there was a major shaking in your life
mentions.falsify_match: A pattern in his own past on the sixes, which only he can attest.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. Worth recording because it sets up 2026 as another six year.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord keeps talking about bringing the closers and the refiners, that there is a remnant already refined, and that he keeps refining them even more.
mentions.quote: there's a remnant of us that have already been refined
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says most people in ministry are judged about the gold, the glory and the girls, and that for what he saw coming in 2026 it is not going to be about the gold and the glory.
mentions.quote: Most people are judged in ministry about that. The gold, the glory, the girls
mentions.falsify_match: Ministry falls in 2026 driven by something other than money, fame or sex.
mentions.falsify_miss: They are driven by exactly those. Note this contradicts the 17 December telling, where the gold, the girls and the glory are given as the cause.

mentions.claim_text: He says that as they go through 2026 they are preparing for the revival, and prays that everyone present gets their heart ready for what is coming in 2026 and makes sure their lamps are full of oil.
mentions.quote: as you go through 2026, you're preparing for the revival
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: 2026 is here recast as the preparation rather than the event, which moves the revival out again.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says they are shredding evidence, repeating shredding, that it is like a whitewashing of the computers everywhere they go, and that they are infiltrated in the least likely areas anyone expects.
mentions.quote: They're shredding the evidence. It's like a whitewashing of the computers
mentions.falsify_match: A documented destruction of records.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Nobody is named and no institution is identified.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is calling the people to wake up, that it grieved him when he could see it, and repeats that America has turned its back on him, many of them, but that there is a remnant.
mentions.quote: America, you have turned your back upon me. Many of them
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a verdict on a nation's spiritual state.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says to watch a crackdown with Facebook and with freedom of speech more on Facebook, that this is what the Lord said, comparing it to how they did it with covid and calling things fake news.
mentions.quote: watch a crackdown with Facebook watch a crackdown with freedom of speech
mentions.falsify_match: New content restrictions on Facebook.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Platform moderation changes constantly, so this is close to unmissable.

mentions.claim_text: He says the major networks are bringing a new alternative and trying to take out the alternative with Elon concerning the elections in 2026 and 2028, and that this is how they will try to have a new Watergate.
mentions.quote: This is how they will try to have a new Watergate
mentions.falsify_match: A major political scandal engineered around the two elections.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. New Watergate is not defined.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees so much drama concerning Europe and these other nations, repeats Europe several times, says it is very serious and concerns America too, and thanks God for President Trump because with Kamala in office it would be very bad.
mentions.quote: I see so much drama concerning Europe
mentions.falsify_match: A serious European crisis.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Drama is not defined, and the counterfactual about a different president cannot be tested.

mentions.claim_text: He says the twenty four hour period of change is already happening and they can see it right now, and asks whether they do not feel the escalation since then.
mentions.quote: The 24-hour period of change is already happening
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and the shift is worth noting: a period of twenty four hours in which everything changes is now described as already under way and ongoing.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He asks what is inside him that is repulsive to the Lord, and speaks of being on the potter's wheel, being moulded and made every day, staying in glory to glory, and cultivating to accelerate.
mentions.quote: To be on that potter's wheel and be molded and made every day
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says one of the major things Jesus told him when he went to heaven and was on the edge of it was that right before he comes, one of the major things they will see on the earth is that they will talk about aliens a lot.
mentions.quote: right before I come, they'll talk about aliens a lot
mentions.falsify_match: Sustained public attention to unidentified craft, which is already the case.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The condition is arguably satisfied before the prediction was made.

mentions.claim_text: He says to pray for this nation and for the nations of the world because it is not just about America, notes they are having big meetings again today talking about kicking the guy in Venezuela out, and begins to relay what Trump is saying.
mentions.quote: talking about kicking the guy in Venezuela out
mentions.falsify_match: Maduro removed.
mentions.falsify_miss: He remains. This is commentary on reported meetings rather than a sight.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is all his opinion, that what the Lord showed him concerns January, that Jerome Powell will be out and they are going to try to pump this economy, and that the Lord told him personally to ride the wave because it is a pig.
mentions.quote: concerning January and then Jerome Powell will be out
mentions.falsify_match: Powell leaving the Federal Reserve in January 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: He stays. His term as chair runs to May 2026, which is public, so January is a real and checkable commitment. He marks the whole thing as opinion.

mentions.claim_text: He says they have three weeks left and to make the change now, to make their New Year's resolution or revolution now and not wait for 2026 to start reading the Bible or praying, and to find him now.
mentions.quote: Don't wait for 2026 to start. Find Him now
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says it is symbolic and the motherboard was not literally on fire but is getting hot, and explains that metal glows cherry red as it heats up.
mentions.quote: It's symbolic. It's not that the motherboard was on fire, but it's getting hot
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and he supplies the reading himself: the image is heat, not fire.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says that as he was seeing a new industrial revolution it got really hot, that he saw the car market and the housing market, and that the Lord said to watch May, to watch the month of May concerning interest rates.
mentions.quote: Watch May. Watch the month of May concerning interest rates
mentions.falsify_match: A notable interest rate development in May 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: A quiet May. Powell's term as chair ends in May 2026, which is public and is the obvious anchor.
